# Joys Homes & Developers

> Premier eco-friendly home builders and construction company in Thrissur, Kerala, India.
> Established construction firm specialising in luxury homes, commercial buildings, interior design, and renovation.

## About

[Joys Homes & Developers](https://joyshomes.com) is a construction company headquartered at Kizhakkepuram Road, Aranattukara, Thrissur, Kerala (PIN 680618), India.
Phone: +91 90486 81007

The company builds sustainable, eco-friendly residential homes and commercial buildings across Kerala, with a focus on quality craftsmanship, transparent pricing, and client satisfaction.

## Services

- [Luxury Home Construction](https://joyshomes.com/#services) — Custom homes designed and built to specification, from foundation to handover.
- [Eco-Friendly Green Building](https://joyshomes.com/#services) — Sustainable construction using low-carbon materials, rainwater harvesting, solar-ready designs.
- [Commercial Construction](https://joyshomes.com/#services) — Office buildings, retail spaces, and mixed-use developments.
- [Interior Design & Fit-Out](https://joyshomes.com/#services) — End-to-end interior design for residential and commercial projects.
- [Renovation & Remodelling](https://joyshomes.com/#services) — Modernising existing homes and commercial spaces in Kerala.
- [Architectural Design](https://joyshomes.com/#services) — In-house architecture services for bespoke designs.

## Service Area

Kerala, India — including Thrissur, Kochi, Kozhikode, Kottayam, Palakkad, and Kannur.

## Key Facts

- Construction costs start from ₹1,800/sq ft (standard) to ₹2,500+/sq ft (luxury)
- Typical home build time: 12–18 months
- Single point of contact: design → construction → interior fit-out
- Eco-friendly practices: rainwater harvesting, solar-ready, energy-efficient layouts
